[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size]
[/b]
This is a collection of retextured user interfaces for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley[/url].
There haven't been many patches on Nexus, so I decided to share my own.

Some edits are made for my personal preferences. Some are OC.
Some edits are admittedly rough and made in a few minutes.

Only provided what's in my own modlist. Feel free to [u]track this mod[/u].
Recommended mod manager is [url=https://github.com/Modorganizer2/modorganizer/releases]Mod Organizer 2[/url].


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/LOHPDQd.gif[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/RY1ed5I.gif[/img][/center]
